title: Sequential Detergent and Salt-based Subcellular Fractionation of Human Neural Stem Cells
author: Katja Piltti
materials: Detach the cells using a cell scraper in 500 μL PBS (0.1 mM Ca²⁺ and 1 mM Mg²⁺) supplemented with protease inhibitor (Roche Applied Science, cOmplete ULTRA, 05892970001) and phosphatase inhibitor (Roche Applied Science, PhosSTOP, 04906837001). Keep on ice to prevent protein degradation.

steps.title: Prepare Human Neural Stem Cells
steps.instruction: Culture and wash the human neural stem cells (hNSC) to prepare them for fractionation.

substeps.instruction: Culture hNSC on poly-L-ornithine and laminin-coated 6-well plates in growth medium (GM).
Wash hNSC twice with cold Dulbecco's Phosphate-Buffered Saline without Ca 2+ /Mg 2+ (DPBS -/-).

steps.title: Extract PBS-Soluble Cytoplasmic Fraction
steps.instruction: Homogenize the detached cells and isolate the cytoplasmic protein fraction.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize detached cells by passing them through a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 27.5 G needle using 10 up-and-down strokes.
Incubate the homogenate on ice for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C using a pre-cooled centrifuge.
Collect the supernatant as the PBS-soluble cytoplasmic protein fraction.

steps.title: Extract Detergent-Soluble Membrane Fraction
steps.instruction: Solubilize membrane proteins from the remaining cell pellet using Triton X-100.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 500μL of lysis buffer containing 50mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.5), 100mM NaCl, 0.5% Triton X-100, and protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
Perform 10 additional up-and-down strokes using a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 35 G needle.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant as the detergent (TX-100)-soluble membrane/subcellular structure protein fraction.

steps.title: Extract Nuclear Protein Fraction
steps.instruction: Extract nuclear proteins from the remaining pellet using a high-salt buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining pellet in 200μL of lysis buffer containing 0.5M KCl and protease and phosphatase inhibitors.
Collect the supernatant as the TX-100+ KCl-nuclear protein fraction.

steps.title: Prepare Final Pellet for Analysis
steps.instruction: Denature the final pellet proteins for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 20μL of 5X SDS-PAGE sample loading buffer (250mM Tris-HCl, pH 6.8, 10% SDS, 30% glycerol, 10mM DTT, 0.05% bromophenol blue).

steps.title: Analyze Protein Fractions
steps.instruction: Perform Western blot analysis on the collected fractions.

substeps.instruction: Analyze 10μg of protein from each fraction using Western blot with antibodies specific to compartment markers and loading controls.
